description: Post-resolution first-wins dedup observed through the POLICY channel. Loads ro and en with fallback en; no mo catalog exists, so every mo observation is resolution behavior rather than loading behavior. Requesting mo-MD produces a raw candidate set containing both mo and ro, but localizedStringsFor folds each raw candidate onto a catalog BEFORE the putIfAbsent at DefaultStrings.java:2498, which is keyed by that RESOLVED attempted locale; the executed chain is therefore exactly [mo-MD, ro, ro-MD, en] — measured, not assumed — with raw mo already collapsed onto loaded ro and the later raw ro candidate producing NO second entry and hence no second consultation. Requesting bare mo collapses further to [ro, en], with mo absent from attemptedLocales entirely. Dedup.OnlyInRo and Dedup.OnlyInEn separate the two catalogs, Dedup.Shared exists in both so first-wins is visible, and Dedup.Missing exists nowhere. Loaded ro and en have distinct primary language codes, so no tiebreakers are required.
